product_metadata.title: OXO 1452880 Good Grips Shower Curtain Liner Splash Guard Clip
features: Clips secure shower curtain liner to the wall, keeping water contained
Non-slip grips keep liner clipped in tight
Grips hold liner between wall and Clips for a secure seal
Adhesive tape keeps Clips in place on walls
description: Slash the splash with the OXO GG Shower Curtain Clips. These handy Clips hold shower curtain liners against the wall, keeping water from splashing out onto the floor. The non-slip grips help keep the liner in place and help create a secure seal. The Clips have adhesive tape for easy, no-tool installation.
